translations.answer: Not. The original thread explicitly stated that not all features are available. Pinocchio v3.5.0 only lists the mimic parameter (default false) for buildModel, and forward kinematics, Jacobians/frames, ccrba, RNEA, CRBA, and reachable workspace mimic support. Engineering practice should pass mimic=True and verify algorithm by version release; continuous mimic URDF parsing requires v3.8.0/#2756.
translations.applicability: Applies to WBC models using Pinocchio 3.x/4.x for mimic joints; specifics remain to be verified with target version release and regression testing.
translations.credibility.rationale: Issue closed, environment clear, and no conflict. Formal documentation or independent reproducibility is present.
translations.details.attempts.0: Maintainer and users discussed whether to remove actuator DOF from final user state, and expectations for FK/FD/ID constraints.
translations.details.diagnostics.0: Verify URDF parser switch, mimic/mimicked list in model, and whether target algorithm is listed in corresponding version release.
translations.details.effective_fixes.0: Use buildModel(..., mimic=True) in Pinocchio 3.5.0 or later to parse mimic fields, and only list FK, Jacobian, ccrba, RNEA, CRBA, and reachable workspace in v3.5.0 release.
translations.details.environments.0: Originates from 2020 legacy versions; closed with Pinocchio 3.5.0 and PR #2441.
translations.details.limits.0: Original thread explicitly stated not all Pinocchio features are available for mimic; algorithms not listed in v3.5.0 release cannot be inferred as supported.
translations.details.limits.1: Continuous mimic URDF parsing requires v3.8.0/#2756, not just general support declaration from v3.5.0.
translations.details.outcomes.0: Maintainer stated in 2025-03-03 that issue closed and issue resolved; v3.5.0 release lists parsing API, supported algorithms, and new model data field.
translations.details.problem_statements.0: What WBC algorithms are explicitly supported from which Pinocchio version onwards?
translations.details.safety_notes.0: Before real-world WBC, verify each algorithm for mimic constraint regression and ensure state/force vector dimensions do not treat actuator DOF as independent executors.
translations.details.suspected_causes.0: Historical versions did not provide complete delivery of mimic joint data structure, parser entry, and algorithm coverage; maintainer also warned that not all features are available.
translations.details.symptoms.0: Users cannot confirm whether forward dynamics, FK, IK/Jacobian, etc., automatically comply with referent-mimic constraints.
translations.source.locator: Pinocchio #1290 maintainer version boundary and #2441 closure; v3.5.0 release algorithm list; v3.8.0 continuous mimic supplement.
translations.source.title: Pinocchio mimic joint support requires version and algorithm verification.
